//: Node resolves a file's module type from the nearest package.json. The repo root has no "type", so scripts/*.js are CommonJS and stay that way — but update-cask.ts is ESM, and without this marker Node parses it as CommonJS, fails, reparses it as ESM and prints MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON on every run. This directory, and only this directory, is ESM.
name: @joinery/release-scripts
